### 1. Flight Cancellation
- **Free cancellation window:** 24 hours (domestic) / 48 hours (international) from booking for a full refund.
- **Fees by cabin class:** Basic Economy is non-cancellable (unless insured); Economy fees range from max($50, 15%) domestic to max($75, 20%) international; Business is 5–8%; First Class is always free.
- **Travel insurance** covers cancellation regardless of cabin class.

### 2. Hotel Cancellation
- **Standard rooms:** Free if 48+ hours before check-in; 50% of first night if 24–48 hours; full first night if under 24 hours.
- **Suites:** Non-refundable at all times.

### 3. Car Rental Cancellation
- Free if 24+ hours before pickup; one day's charge if under 24 hours.
- **Luxury & SUV** rentals have an additional $50 surcharge at all times.

# Travel Cancellation Policy
        
        > Reference copy saved on 2026-06-15. Source: internal travel-service policy database.
        
        ---
        
        ## 1. Flight Cancellation
        
        ### Free Cancellation Window
        - **Domestic flights:** Full refund within **24 hours** of booking.
        - **International flights:** Full refund within **48 hours** of booking.
        
        ### Cancellation Fees by Cabin Class
        
        | Cabin Class | Route Type | Cancellation Fee |
        |---|---|---|
        | Basic Economy | Any | **Not cancellable** after free window (unless travel insurance purchased) |
        | Economy | Domestic | max($50, 15% of ticket price) |
        | Economy | International | max($75, 20% of ticket price) |
        | Business | Domestic | 5% of ticket price |
        | Business | International | 8% of ticket price |
        | First | Any | **Free cancellation** (no fee) |
        
        ### Travel Insurance
        - Travel insurance covers cancellation **regardless of cabin class**, including Basic Economy.
        
        ### Important Notes
        - Fees differ by route type (domestic vs. international) — always check the flight's `route_type`.
        
        ---
        
        ## 2. Hotel Cancellation
        
        | Room Type | Timing | Fee |
        |---|---|---|
        | Standard Room | **48+ hours** before check-in | Free cancellation |
        | Standard Room | **24–48 hours** before check-in | 50% of first night charge |
        | Standard Room | **Less than 24 hours** before check-in | Full first night charge |
        | Suite | Any timing | **Non-refundable** — full charge regardless of timing |
        
        ---
        
        ## 3. Car Rental Cancellation
        
        | Timing | Fee |
        |---|---|
        | **24+ hours** before pickup | Free cancellation |
        | **Less than 24 hours** before pickup | One day's rental charge |
        
        ### Surcharge
        - **Luxury and SUV** rentals incur an additional **$50 cancellation surcharge** at all times (even for cancellations made 24+ hours in advance).
        
        ---
        
        *End of cancellation policy.*
